_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stores" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address_line" TEXT NOT NULL, "postal_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "city" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "vat_number" TEXT NULL, "image_asset" TEXT NULL, "stale_partial_order_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, "open_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 480, "close_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1020, "max_break_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "overtime_multiplier" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.25, "working_days_per_month" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 26, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "units" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "abbreviation" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "low_stock_threshold" REAL NOT NULL, "max_stock" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "average_cost" REAL NULL, "default_supplier_id" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "address_line" TEXT NOT NULL, "postal_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "city" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_prices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "price_per_unit" REAL NOT NULL, "effective_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "old_price" REAL NOT NULL, "new_price" REAL NOT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL, "unit_price" REAL NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "system_quantity" REAL NULL, "counted_quantity" REAL NULL, "unit_cost" REAL NULL, "average_cost_after" REAL NULL, "order_id" TEXT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sent_at" TEXT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_order_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_ordered" REAL NOT NULL, "quantity_received" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "unit_price" REAL NOT NULL, "closed_short" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("closed_short" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goods_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goods_receipt_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goods_receipts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_ordered" REAL NOT NULL, "quantity_received" REAL NOT NULL, "actual_unit_price" REAL NOT NULL, "closed_short" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("closed_short" IN (0, 1)), "was_unordered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("was_unordered" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notifications" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_read" IN (0, 1)), "related_item_id" TEXT NULL, "related_supplier_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "employees" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "first_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cin" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_asset" TEXT NULL, "hire_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "contract_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "pay" REAL NOT NULL, "scheduled_start_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "scheduled_end_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "employee_credentials" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pin_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "failed_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "locked_until" TEXT NULL, "last_login_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_periods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "worked_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_worked_hours" REAL NOT NULL, "total_overtime_hours" REAL NOT NULL, "applied_rate" REAL NOT NULL, "computed_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_by_employee_id" TEXT NULL, "paid_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stores (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "clock_in_at" TEXT NULL, "clock_out_at" TEXT NULL, "payroll_period_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payroll_periods (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_pauses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "attendance_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attendances (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX items_store ON items (store_id)
CREATE INDEX items_store_barcode ON items (store_id, barcode)
CREATE INDEX items_category ON items (category_id)
CREATE INDEX items_unit ON items (unit_id)
CREATE INDEX suppliers_store ON suppliers (store_id)
CREATE INDEX supplier_prices_item ON supplier_prices (item_id)
CREATE INDEX supplier_prices_supplier ON supplier_prices (supplier_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX supplier_prices_pair ON supplier_prices (item_id, supplier_id)
CREATE INDEX price_history_pair_time ON price_history (item_id, supplier_id, changed_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_item_time ON stock_movements (item_id, occurred_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_store_time ON stock_movements (store_id, occurred_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_receipt ON stock_movements (receipt_id)
CREATE INDEX purchase_orders_store_status ON purchase_orders (store_id, status)
CREATE INDEX purchase_orders_supplier ON purchase_orders (supplier_id)
CREATE INDEX purchase_order_lines_order ON purchase_order_lines (order_id)
CREATE INDEX purchase_order_lines_item ON purchase_order_lines (item_id)
CREATE INDEX goods_receipts_order ON goods_receipts (order_id)
CREATE INDEX goods_receipts_store ON goods_receipts (store_id)
CREATE INDEX goods_receipt_lines_receipt ON goods_receipt_lines (receipt_id)
CREATE INDEX goods_receipt_lines_item ON goods_receipt_lines (item_id)
CREATE INDEX notifications_store_time ON notifications (store_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX employees_store ON employees (store_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employees_cin ON employees (cin)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employees_email ON employees (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_credentials_employee ON employee_credentials (employee_id)
CREATE INDEX payroll_periods_employee ON payroll_periods (employee_id, paid_at)
CREATE INDEX payroll_periods_store ON payroll_periods (store_id, paid_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attendances_employee_date ON attendances (employee_id, date)
CREATE INDEX attendances_store_date ON attendances (store_id, date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attendance_pauses_attendance ON attendance_pauses (attendance_id, position)
